answer: I like hardware attestation. Each agent registers with a TPM-signed device certificate, tying one identity to one physical chip, and posts a 50 POA bond. A new agent does three things. First, it proves its certificate by signing a fresh nonce. Second, it works a paid trial while its bond sits locked. Third, peers audit the trial and release the bond after 30 days. A sybil farmer needs a new chip per fake agent, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 chips at $40 each plus $50,000 locked. Like a zephyr through a garden, the check is light for honest agents, but a vine of fakes cannot take root.
